# Erson Studio — Brand Content Strategy & Professional Video Editing

> Erson (Diwash Ghimire) is a Brand Content Strategist & Professional Video Editor with over 3 years of experience. He helps brands, founders, and creators transform raw video footage into retention-driven assets that build brand identity, boost watch time, and drive repeat conversions.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Content Strategy**: Systematized content frameworks, brand positioning, scripting structure, and recurring upload strategy.
- **Video Production & Post-Production**: High-retention video editing, cinematic color grading (DaVinci Resolve), motion graphics (Adobe Premiere Pro & After Effects), sound design, and audio mastering.
- **Content Partnership Retainers**: Dedicated ongoing monthly video production partnership for brands scaling output.

## Proven Track Record & Performance Statistics
- **Scaling Impressions**: Scaled brand YouTube channels from 8,000 monthly views to over 10,000,000+ (10M+) monthly impressions.
- **Audience Retention**: Achieved up to 85% average view duration using 3-second hook strategies and micro-animation pattern interrupts.
- **Client Reputation**: 4.9/5 average rating across 48+ client reviews (94% rated 5 stars).
- **Key Clients & Partners**: Kantipur Media Group, CG Communications, Uptrendly Media, Compass Wealth Management, Monaco Pool, Huskey Turf Solutions.
